method: Each module GLB is mounted on every full R4 port of every block: module socket 30 mm off the port centre along the port normal (two 0.52 m blocks on the 0.55 m grid), socket direction against the normal, 4 rolls (0/90/180/270 deg). contact: 13x13 rays over 0.42 m in the gap, both faces flush at 15 mm +-0.6 mm from the mid-plane, nothing protruding or missing (PASS >= 70% flush, recesses allowed). overlap: BVH overlap of all non-FX module meshes at 10 sampled frames of the whole animation timeline with the whole block (all cells).
